experimental.method: Add a 'frozen-frontier pre-market markdown' composite test that fires when meta.todayEt ADVANCES to a new calendar date AND snapshot.window is a pre-session window (pre-market) AND dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is UNCHANGED from the prior window AND the swing bar count is UNCHANGED (delta 0) AND freshSymbolCount==symbolCount with carriedSymbolCount==0 and missingSymbolCount==0. Assert FOUR joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER FROZEN = expectedSessionDate and swing bars both unchanged across a calendar-day advance, so any repeated rotation leg MUST NOT increment its distinct-completed-bar-date persistence counter (the anti-double-count guard: distinct bar dates, not intraday/inter-window re-runs); (2) BENCH MARKDOWN = the deterministic bench px falls and pctFrom52wHigh turns more negative versus the prior window (757.67 -> 747.03; 0 -> -1.4) while maStack stays bull-stack; (3) OWNER-READ CARRY = the owning-tool headless reads (swing, options-structure, gamma, intraday, vol-sizing, breadth) are unchanged in asOf/values, i.e. the reprice is confined to the live bench/regime layer, not the completed-bar owner reads; (4) FLIP PROXIMITY = the marked-down live bench closes to within a small band above the carried-forward positive-gamma flip (747.03 vs 743.36, ~0.5%). Emit the experimental flag only when (1) holds AND at least two of (2)-(4) co-occur, so an ordinary quiet pre-market re-read (frontier frozen, bench roughly flat) does not trip it and only a genuine same-frontier markdown toward structural levels is surfaced.
